thread.title: These are the top stock picks for 2019 among Wall Street analysts

author: Philip van Doorn
title: These are the top stock picks for 2019 among Wall Street analysts
text:
After U.S. stocks last year posted the worst performance since 2008, you might be skeptical of companies favored by Wall Street analysts, who seem to be perennially optimistic. But having a lot of “buy” ratings from analysts means support from brokers and advisers, which could help share prices.
To be sure, sell-side analysts shy away from making clear recommendations to sell a stock. Among the S&P 500 SPX, -0.23% there is not a single company with majority “sell” or equivalent ratings among analysts polled by FactSet.
But it is a new year, so let’s go along with the program and accentuate the positive by listing the favored large-cap stocks as well as those in the S&P 400 Mid-Cap Index SPX, -0.23% and the S&P 600 Small-Cap Index SML, -0.08% For each index, we’ll list 20 stocks covered by at least five analysts with 75% or more “buy” or equivalent ratings that have the highest 12-month upside potential implied by consensus price targets.
